# Invonics Technologies

> Invonics Technologies is a custom software and AI automation company in Nairobi, Kenya. It builds custom software, AI automation, web platforms and brand systems for businesses and schools in Nairobi, Kenya and across East Africa.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://invonicstechnologies.com/): Overview of the company, its services and flagship solutions
- [About](https://invonicstechnologies.com/about): About Invonics Technologies
- [Portfolio and case studies](https://invonicstechnologies.com/portfolio): Software platforms, automation systems and digital ecosystems built by Invonics Technologies
- [Blog](https://invonicstechnologies.com/blog): Field notes on software architecture, AI automation and building for African businesses
- [Contact](https://invonicstechnologies.com/contact): Send an inquiry to the team

## Case studies
- [Accounting & Finance System](https://invonicstechnologies.com/portfolio/accounting-finance-system): KRA-compliant double-entry accounting for Kenyan sole proprietors and micro-businesses, with automatic Turnover Tax, P&L reports and a full audit trail.
- [Event RSVP Automation Platform](https://invonicstechnologies.com/portfolio/event-rsvp-automation): Read the case study on how Invonics Technologies built an automated Event RSVP platform to streamline guest management and event check-ins.
- [Restaurant Management System](https://invonicstechnologies.com/portfolio/restaurant-management-system): Discover how Invonics Technologies is building a unified Restaurant Management System integrating POS, online ordering, and room bookings.
- [School Asset & Inventory System](https://invonicstechnologies.com/portfolio/school-asset-inventory-system): A role-based school asset and inventory system with loan tracking, automated invoicing and an audit trail for schools in Kenya. Try the live demo.

## Services
- [Custom Software & Web Platforms](https://invonicstechnologies.com/services/custom-software-and-web-platforms): Custom websites, web apps and Android and iPhone apps built in Nairobi. M-Pesa payments, a private staging link and a full handover pack.

## Blog posts
- [Motion Grid: A New Paradigm for Animated Layouts](https://invonicstechnologies.com/blog/motion-grid-a-new-paradigm-for-animated-layouts): Motion grids combine the power of CSS Grid with fluid animations to create dynamic, visually compelling layouts that elevate user experience.
- [Clean Architecture in Practice: Structuring a Scalable Backend](https://invonicstechnologies.com/blog/clean-architecture-scalable-backend): Layered boundaries keep your codebase adaptable. Here's how to apply clean architecture without the dogma.
- [A Practical Guide to Building AI Features Without Overengineering](https://invonicstechnologies.com/blog/practical-guide-building-ai-features): AI doesn't have to mean massive infrastructure. Here's how to ship valuable AI features quickly and responsibly.
